findings.reader: A well-bounded, plainly written news report: it motivates the urgent frozen-section job, explains the frozen-versus-FFPE training mechanism, reports the model-comparison and reader-study results with attribution, and keeps the crucial limit — observed performance is not proof of better care — visible from headline to close. No defect families present.
findings.facts: All material claims check out against the Nature Medicine excerpts: frozen-specific training rationale, superiority over comparator models, reader-study parity with the senior pathologist, and the 100-case simulated timing analysis, with the interventional-study gap accurately reported. Dates and attribution are sound.
